title: "JSXGraph board in a tab: reproduction"

This page is built on its own, with old commits: the JSXGraph Quarto
extension as ctm-demo used it on 22 September 2026 (math-exercise
`dad1ddd`; its filter is the same as jsxgraph-quarto main `59d549c`) and
the original code of the solenoid figure (ctm-demo `60b1cb0`). The
JSXGraph library itself is loaded from the CDN, as then.

To see the problem:

1.  Open the tab **2025**, then **Prøve 4**. The board shows correctly.
2.  Make the window narrow, or turn a phone to portrait. The board keeps its
    wide size and is cut off on the right; it does not follow the page.

[Back to the course](https://aacchhee.github.io/ctm-demo/)

### Prøve 4

```{.jsxgraph width="760" height="320" style="width:100%;max-width:760px;height:320px;border:0;"}
var b=JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID,{boundingbox:[-1,3,14,-3],axis:false,keepaspectratio:false,showNavigation:false,showCopyright:false});
var x0=1,x1=11.7,turns=30;
for(var i=0;i<turns;i++){
  var x=x0+i*(x1-x0)/(turns-1),outerX=[],outerY=[],innerX=[],innerY=[];
  for(var j=0;j<=64;j++){
    var angle=2*Math.PI*j/64,dx=.16*Math.cos(angle);
    outerX.push(x+dx); outerY.push(1.75*Math.sin(angle));
    innerX.push(x+dx); innerY.push(.75*Math.sin(angle));
  }
  b.create('curve',[outerX,outerY],{strokeColor:'#1565c0',strokeWidth:1.35,fixed:true,highlight:false});
  b.create('curve',[innerX,innerY],{strokeColor:'#9b1c31',strokeWidth:1.35,fixed:true,highlight:false});
}
b.create('segment',[[.6,0],[13.3,0]],{strokeColor:'#243447',strokeWidth:1.5,fixed:true,highlight:false});
b.create('segment',[[x0,-2.35],[x1,-2.35]],{strokeColor:'#243447',firstArrow:true,lastArrow:true,fixed:true,highlight:false});
b.create('segment',[[x0,-2.15],[x0,-1.85]],{strokeColor:'#243447',dash:2,fixed:true,highlight:false});
b.create('segment',[[x1,-2.15],[x1,-1.85]],{strokeColor:'#243447',dash:2,fixed:true,highlight:false});
b.create('text',[(x0+x1)/2,-2.65,'lengde ℓ'],{fixed:true,fontSize:18,anchorX:'middle'}); b.create('text',[12.2,.65,'a'],{fixed:true,color:'#9b1c31',fontSize:17}); b.create('text',[12.2,1.65,'2a'],{fixed:true,color:'#1565c0',fontSize:17});
var graphBox=document.querySelector('.jxgbox'); function fitBoard(){var w=graphBox.clientWidth,h=graphBox.clientHeight;if(w>0&&h>0){b.resizeContainer(w,h,true);b.fullUpdate();}}
if(typeof ResizeObserver!=='undefined')new ResizeObserver(fitBoard).observe(graphBox); window.addEventListener('pageshow',fitBoard);
```
